patches.name: Bossa Nova
patches.note: ii-V-I in C. The clave is drawn as distance, one cell a sixteenth.

patches.name: Samba
patches.note: Surdo, caixa, ganzá, tamborim, agogô and cuíca, with a cavaquinho off the beat and a flute over the top.

patches.name: House
patches.note: Four to the floor at 124. The open hat is the kick’s clock, drawn an eighth longer.

patches.name: Hip-Hop
patches.note: Boom-bap at 88, hats swung. One clock a bar, three kicks at their own distances.

patches.name: Ambient
patches.note: Five loops of 5, 7, 11, 13 and 16 beats. They come back into line once a day.
